query:
SELECT 'listings' as tbl,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as s1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='reserved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as s2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='sold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as s3,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='inactive' OR status='removed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as s4,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='draft' OR status='pending_review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as s5
FROM marketplaceListings
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders',
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='pending_payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='paid' OR orderStatus='paid_held' OR orderStatus='payment_received' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='shipped' OR orderStatus='delivered' OR orderStatus='completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='disputed' OR orderStatus='refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM marketplaceOrders
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sellers',
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='suspended' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  0
FROM sellerProfiles
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cartItems', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM cartItems
UNION ALL
SELECT 'offers',
  COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' OR status='expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  0
FROM offers;
